description: Thresholds for the Pharos redemption-backed asset gate

require_redemption_available.description: When true, an asset with no redemption route reported by Pharos denies outright.

approved_route_families.description: Pharos redemption route families the curator will accept. Observed values include 'offchain-issuer'.

approved_access_models.description: Pharos redemption access models the curator will accept. Observed values include 'issuer-api'. Governs who may redeem.

approved_settlement_models.description: Pharos settlement models the curator will accept. Observed values include 'same-day'.

required_route_status.description: The route status the asset must report to be admissible. Pharos reports 'open' for a working route - NOT 'active'.

min_route_score.description: Minimum Pharos redemption route score (0-100), the composite quality measure across access, settlement, capacity, cost and execution certainty. Pharos exposes no 0-1 confidence value; capacity_confidence is a qualitative band, not a number.

approved_capacity_confidence.description: Acceptable qualitative capacity-confidence bands. Observed values include 'documented-bound'. Empty array disables this check.

min_capacity_multiple.description: Minimum ratio of the route's IMMEDIATE redemption capacity to the intended position. Pharos publishes an immediate capacity bound rather than a daily limit, so this sizes the position against what can be redeemed right now.

max_reserve_elevated_risk_pct.description: Maximum share (0-100) of reserves sitting in slices Pharos rates worse than low risk. Null reserve data fails soft.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Pharos observation. The redemption-backstops feed refreshes on the order of hours, so values below ~4h will deny routinely. A null age fails soft here; list data_age_seconds in deny_on_missing_fields to catch it instead.

deny_on_missing_fields.description: Field names the oracle must actually report. A null on a listed field denies as missing_<field>; unlisted fields fail soft. An empty list opts out entirely. NOTE: Pharos omits capacity_multiple whenever the caller passes no position size, so leave it unlisted unless every call supplies one.
